findings.summary: Graphify 0.9.2 installed its project Codex skill under .codex/skills, while current official Codex documentation specifies .agents/skills for repository-local skill discovery.
findings.description: Graphify 0.9.2 installed its project Codex skill under .codex/skills, while current official Codex documentation specifies .agents/skills for repository-local skill discovery.
findings.root_cause: The Graphify installer source was treated as authoritative for Codex discovery, and validation checked file presence instead of actual discovery by a fresh Codex session.
findings.consequence: The repository could report a completed Codex integration even though Codex might not expose or invoke the Graphify skill.
findings.disposition: accepted as corrected by human final decision on 2026-07-30; actual fresh Codex discovery verified at .agents/skills/graphify/SKILL.md

findings.summary: Fresh-session pi discovery demonstrated that pi automatically discovers .agents/skills/graphify and shadows the same-named global pi Graphify skill.
findings.description: Fresh-session pi discovery demonstrated that pi automatically discovers the repository-local .agents/skills/graphify skill and shadows the same-named global pi Graphify skill. This contradicted the previously documented discovery-surface model and created a potential duplicate instruction path through .pi/skills/use-graphify.
findings.root_cause: The documented discovery model treated .agents/skills and .pi/skills as separate unless directly bridged, but fresh-session pi discovery showed .agents/skills is visible to pi in this environment and takes precedence over the global fallback.
findings.consequence: The repository could retain overlapping project-local Graphify instruction paths and misreport which Graphify skill pi would invoke during final acceptance.
findings.disposition: resolved and accepted by human final decision on 2026-07-30; .agents/skills/graphify is the shared project Graphify skill for both Codex and pi in the validated environment; .pi/skills/use-graphify removed; global pi fallback left unmodified and intentionally shadowed
